# P3D mandatory final review (read-only)

Scope: packet `docs/cursor-packets/P3D-representative-details.md`, worker report, detail projection/access/routes/proxy/search/hubs, three SSG pages, `DetailViews` / audio / practice / CSS, `learner-details.json`, `p3d-details*.test.ts`, and P3C linkability regression.

---

## P2 — Runtime detail assert does not bind `representatives` ↔ `representativesById` (serve path uses `byId` only)

**Risk:** A tampered `learner-details.json` can keep `representatives[]` valid while mutating `representativesById[id]` (e.g. wrong `sein` forms or Q&A strings). `assertLearnerDetailProjection` only checks `byId.id === record.id`, not structural equality. Pages load **`representativesById`**, not the array.

**Evidence:**

```49:49:platform/apps/web/app/vocabulary/[entityId]/page.tsx
  const detail = details.representativesById[entityId];
```

```531:540:platform/apps/web/lib/content/access.ts
  for (const record of parsed.representatives) {
    assertDetailRecord(record);
    // ...
    const byId = parsed.representativesById[record.id as DetailRepresentativeId];
    if (byId == null || byId.id !== record.id) {
      throw new Error("Detail representativesById is inconsistent");
    }
  }
```

**Fix:** After `assertDetailRecord` per id, require deep equality (e.g. `stableStringify(record) === stableStringify(byId)` using the same sorter as projection, or compare canonical JSON per representative). Add a negative test that mutates only `representativesById["verb:sein"].present[0].form` and expects `assertLearnerDetailProjection` to throw.

---

## P2 — Runtime assert does not pin learner-visible German (only build-time projection test does)

**Risk:** Same tamper class: `assertDetailRecord` checks counts, ids, plural gap, and morphology constants but **not** exact `displayText`, seven `sein` forms, or Q&A realizations. Invented German that avoids forbidden substrings (e.g. no `Architekten`) can pass `loadLearnerDetailProjection()` at runtime.

**Evidence:** `assertDetailRecord` verb/QA branches — `access.ts` ~483–498 (length/register only). Golden strings are enforced in `p3d-details.test.ts` ~110–124 against the bundle, not in `assertLearnerDetailProjection`.

**Fix:** In `assertDetailRecord` (or a single post-projection golden block), assert fixed literals aligned with the validated bundle: e.g. `question.realization === "Was bist du von Beruf?"`, the three answer realizations, `displayText` / `personForm.relatedDisplayText`, and ordered `present[].form` for `verb:sein`. Optionally derive once at build from `projectPublishedLearnerDetails` and embed a hash in the artifact; runtime assert compares hash or literals.

---

## P2 — Approved-media UI can show an enabled “Play” control with no playback wiring

**Risk:** If artifact were tampered to `media.state === "approved"` with non-null `assetId` (assert allows that shape), UI renders a **non-disabled** play button with no `<audio>`, `onClick`, or URL — adjacent to “no fake playback” requirements.

**Evidence:**

```68:82:platform/apps/web/components/audio/PronunciationControl.tsx
  if (control.canPlay) {
    return (
      // ...
        <button
          type="button"
          className="btn btn-secondary audio-control__btn"
          aria-label={`Play ${label}`}
        >
          Play pronunciation
        </button>
```

**Fix:** Until playback is wired, keep approved state disabled with honest copy (“approved; activation pending”), or require a server-only feature flag before `canPlay: true`. Harden assert in production builds so `approved` is rejected until activation is implemented (if policy is “no approved in P3D”).

---

## Checked areas — no other actionable P0–P2 found

| Area | Result |
|------|--------|
| **Review/draft leaks** | No `Architekten` / `Architektinnen`, `.mp3`, `media/generated`, `candidate-needs-listening-review`, or assertion paths in artifact/UI tests; `access.ts` forbidden walkers ~413–418, 566–585. |
| **Representatives only** | `DETAIL_REPRESENTATIVE_IDS` + route/search/hub gating; `lex:architektin` hub/search `canonicalHref: null` (`learner-search.json` ~1209–1218). |
| **German content (honest build)** | Artifact matches bundle: `der Architekt` / `die Architektin`, empty plurals + gap copy, seven `sein` forms, informal Q&A strings (`learner-details.json` ~1–172). |
| **Media honesty** | All three `pending-review`, `assetId: null`; pending copy matches packet (`media-copy.ts` ~3–4); no audio elements in web tree. |
| **Routes / SSG** | Encoded canonical paths, raw-colon → 308 (`routes.ts` ~120–176), wrong-kind/unknown/malformed/extra → `not-found` (`p3d-details.test.ts` ~205–220); proxy uses raw pathname + details (`proxy.ts` ~21–30). |
| **Nav / open redirect** | `isSafeNavigationPath` + `parseNavigationContextParam` fail closed; `SearchViews` `linkableResultHref` ~24–34. |
| **Search/hub links** | `resolveCanonicalHref` only for three ids (`search-project.ts` ~91–94); hub cards via `isDetailRepresentativeId` (`HubViews.tsx` ~65–66). |
| **Deterministic artifact** | `serializeDetailProjectionDeterministic` + disk byte equality test (`p3d-details.test.ts` ~128–133). |
| **Practice honesty** | No `localStorage`/mastery persistence; explicit copy in `VerbSelfCheck.tsx` / `QaPractice.tsx`. |
| **Q&A construction** | `matchPublishedQaPattern` exact normalized match; rejects filled profession (`p3d-details.test.ts` ~280–282). |
| **A11y / semantics** | `GenderBadge` token + label + shape (`GenderBadge.tsx` ~23–44); `lang="de"`; one `<main>` via `AppShell`; disabled controls `tabIndex={-1}` in UI tests. |
| **Prior gates** | P3C preserves 23 activities + detail 404 boundaries (`p3c-search.test.ts` ~392–405); smoke includes detail 200/redirect/404 (`smoke-canonical-routes.mjs` ~176–216). |

---

## Verdict

**Not APPROVE** — three actionable **P2** items: `representativesById` integrity at runtime, missing golden German in `assertLearnerDetailProjection`, and enabled play control when `approved` without real playback.

**Human/content gaps (expected, not defects):** plurals unpublished; TTS listening review pending; P4 review/recorder/mastery/substitution/role-play.
